question: I'm an IS sophomore. I've completed 15-121 (Introduction to Data Structures) and 21-127 (Concepts of Mathematics), but I haven't taken 15-122 or 15-150. Can I register for 15-251 (Great Ideas in Theoretical Computer Science)?
expected_answer: No — 15-251 requires (15-122 at least C OR 15-150 at least C) as the programming prerequisite. 15-121 is NOT listed as an acceptable alternative for 15-251. Having 21-127 satisfies the math component, but the programming component (15-122 or 15-150) is still missing.
reasoning_type: Prerequisite chain — identifying an invalid substitute
common_mistake: Assuming 15-121 is equivalent to 15-122 for 15-251 eligibility because both are intro CS courses; satisfying only one of the two required prerequisite branches
needs_verification: Confirm 15-251 does not accept 15-121 as an alternative to 15-122 or 15-150
Confirm P-013 has not taken 15-122 in a semester not captured here
Verify IS sophomore students are typically eligible for 15-251 if prerequisites are met
